purpose: Primary-source factual leads for the three remaining natural-feature gaps; input-only review evidence.
method: Used primary institutional or peer-reviewed sources to support exact feature identity and relationship to the existing catalogue anchor. Paraphrases only; no external images, maps, geometry, or measurements copied.

candidate.name: Bahía Fildes
candidate.fact_paraphrase: An INACH science-program publication reports biodiversity in Bahía Fildes waters a short distance from Villa Las Estrellas, explicitly linking the named bay to the settlement.
candidate.relationship_to_catalogue_anchor: Primary source describes Bahía Fildes as “a pasos” from Villa Las Estrellas; this is proximity evidence, not a surveyed boundary or exact feature coordinate.

candidate.name: Siachen Glacier
candidate.fact_paraphrase: A peer-reviewed Journal of Glaciology study identifies Siachen Glacier in the East Karakoram and gives its extent as 35°10′–35°42′N and 76°46′–77°25′E.
candidate.relationship_to_catalogue_anchor: The recorded Terong Kangri catalogue point (35.3986779 N, 77.3141384 E) falls inside the article’s latitude/longitude ranges. Those ranges are not a mapped glacier polygon and do not prove exact ice overlap with the named summit.

feature_coordinates.type: published geographic extent range; not a polygon

sources.title: Area and mass changes of Siachen Glacier (East Karakoram)
sources.publisher: Journal of Glaciology, Cambridge University Press
sources.author: Vibhor Agarwal, Tobias Bolch, Tajdarul H. Syed, Tino Pieczonka, Rishabh Nagaich
sources.page_locator: Vol. 63, no. 237 (2017), Study Area; article first published online 2016-12-08

cities.review_note: This supports the named glacier and a broad published extent only; it makes no sovereignty, access, exact summit-overlap or surveyed-shape claim. Current region proposal should be reviewed (Siachen is presently assigned americas-oceania in the catalogue).
cities.status: primary-source lead for parent review; not accepted or approved

candidate.name: Golfe du Morbihan (Kerguelen)

candidate.relationship_to_catalogue_anchor: TAAF explicitly locates the base of Port-aux-Français in the gulf; no exact bay boundary or feature coordinate is supplied.
